There is no second A2A\nabstraction in this release.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003epraval.mcp\u003c/code\u003e is a direct MCP tools client. Provider-hosted MCP descriptors are\na separate experimental provider capability.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eMCP support covers stdio and Streamable HTTP tool discovery and execution. It\ndoes not yet cover resources, prompts, server hosting, OAuth, or rich binary\nresults.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eVoice APIs are request-based STT and TTS. Persistent connections with\ncontinuous audio and event exchange are realtime sessions and are deferred.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eStructured output is constrained by a capable provider. Praval does not claim\nuniversal local JSON Schema validation of provider text.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eReef matches waited replies by request ID, participants, and lifecycle fields.\nApplications still own durable workflow state, retry policy, and business\nidempotency.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eRetries are explicit and provider-specific. Praval does not promise a hidden\nuniversal circuit breaker, storage fallback, or automatic reconnect layer.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003ePravalApp\u003c/code\u003e owns cleanup. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Praval</h1><a id="user-content-praval" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Praval" href="#praval"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Build model-backed agents and message-driven agent teams in Python</strong></p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://pypi.org/project/praval/" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/782af122b6fd0f2aaa77aacfacd05bb6bfc2740aba3ac3cc08870479fca06008/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f707970692f762f70726176616c2e737667" alt="PyPI" data-canonical-src="https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/praval.svg" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<a href="https://pypi.org/project/praval/" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/9e50e3f66e4c81afb481281710eca4241955db5742877e2806c5c89f53679ff7/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f707970692f707976657273696f6e732f70726176616c2e737667" alt="Python" data-canonical-src="https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/praval.svg" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<a href="https://github.com/aiexplorations/praval/blob/main/LICENSE"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/8bb50fd2278f18fc326bf71f6e88ca8f884f72f179d3e555e20ed30157190d0d/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f6c6963656e73652d4d49542d677265656e2e737667" alt="License" data-canonical-src="https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
</div>
<p dir="auto">Praval is a focused Python framework for agent systems. One agent can use a
provider-neutral model runtime, tools, streaming, structured output, memory,
multimodal input, and request-based voice. Teams of agents can collaborate
through a native layer called Reef.</p>
<p dir="auto">You can start small with one <code>Agent</code>, then add Reef and Spores when work needs
to move between specialists. These are two parts of the same framework, not
competing APIs.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Why the 0.8 line starts at 0.8.1</h3><a id="user-content-why-the-08-line-starts-at-081" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Why the 0.8 line starts at 0.8.1" href="#why-the-08-line-starts-at-081"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Version 0.8.0 was briefly uploaded during release preparation, then withdrawn
before Praval created a matching Git tag and GitHub release. PyPI does not
allow a deleted release filename to be reused. Praval therefore moved to
0.8.1 so every supported package has clear, matching provenance. There is no
user migration between 0.8.0 and 0.8.1. Version 0.8.1 is the first supported
release in the 0.8 line.</p>

<p dir="auto">Decorated agents react to Spores delivered by Reef. This example uses custom
handlers, so it can show the collaboration flow without making a paid model
call:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="from praval import agent, broadcast, get_reef, start_agents


@agent("researcher", provider="ollama", responds_to=["research_request"])
def researcher(spore):
    topic = spore.knowledge["topic"]
    broadcast(
        {
            "type": "research_complete",
            "topic": topic,
            "finding": f"Evidence collected for {topic}",
        }
    )


@agent("editor", provider="ollama", responds_to=["research_complete"])
def editor(spore):
    print(spore.knowledge["finding"])


start_agents(
    researcher,
    editor,
    initial_data={"type": "research_request", "topic": "agent systems"},
)
reef = get_reef()
reef.wait_for_completion(timeout=30)
reef.shutdown()"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">praval</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-s1">agent</span>, <span class="pl-s1">broadcast</span>, <span class="pl-s1">get_reef</span>, <span class="pl-s1">start_agents</span>


<span class="pl-en">@<span class="pl-en">agent</span>(<span class="pl-s">"researcher"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">provider</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"ollama"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">responds_to</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>[<span class="pl-s">"research_request"</span>])</span>
<span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">researcher</span>(<span class="pl-s1">spore</span>):
    <span class="pl-s1">topic</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">spore</span>.<span class="pl-c1">knowledge</span>[<span class="pl-s">"topic"</span>]
    <span class="pl-en">broadcast</span>(
        {
            <span class="pl-s">"type"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"research_complete"</span>,
            <span class="pl-s">"topic"</span>: <span class="pl-s1">topic</span>,
            <span class="pl-s">"finding"</span>: <span class="pl-s">f"Evidence collected for <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">topic</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>"</span>,
        }
    )


<span class="pl-en">@<span class="pl-en">agent</span>(<span class="pl-s">"editor"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">provider</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"ollama"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">responds_to</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>[<span class="pl-s">"research_complete"</span>])</span>

)
<span class="pl-s1">reef</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">get_reef</span>()
<span class="pl-s1">reef</span>.<span class="pl-c1">wait_for_completion</span>(<span class="pl-s1">timeout</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">30</span>)
<span class="pl-s1">reef</span>.<span class="pl-c1">shutdown</span>()</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">The in-process Reef is built in. RabbitMQ is the distributed Reef backend.
Redis is a storage provider, not a Reef backend. Start with the
<a href="https://github.com/aiexplorations/praval/blob/main/docs/sphinx/tutorials/first-agent.md">first agent tutorial</a>, then continue to
<a href="https://github.com/aiexplorations/praval/blob/main/docs/sphinx/tutorials/agent-communication.md">agent communication</a> and
<a href="https://github.com/aiexplorations/praval/blob/main/docs/sphinx/tutorials/multi-agent-systems.md">multi-agent systems</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Own the lifecycle with PravalApp</h2><a id="user-content-own-the-lifecycle-with-pravalapp" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Own the lifecycle with PravalApp" href="#own-the-lifecycle-with-pravalapp"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>PravalApp</code> closes registered agents and its Reef when the application exits:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="from praval import PravalApp

with PravalApp() as app:
    assistant = app.create_agent("assistant", provider="openai")
    print(assistant.chat("Say hello in one sentence."))"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">praval</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">PravalApp</span>

<span class="pl-k">with</span> <span class="pl-en">PravalApp</span>() <span class="pl-k">as</span> <span class="pl-s1">app</span>:
    <span class="pl-s1">assistant</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">app</span>.<span class="pl-c1">create_agent</span>(<span class="pl-s">"assistant"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">provider</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"openai"</span>)
    <span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">assistant</span>.<span class="pl-c1">chat</span>(<span class="pl-s">"Say hello in one sentence."</span>))</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">It is a lifecycle owner in this release. It is not a dependency-injection
container, and it does not replace the process-wide provider registry used by
<code>Agent</code>. See <a href="https://github.com/aiexplorations/praval/blob/main/docs/sphinx/guide/application-lifecycle.md">Application lifecycle</a>
for cleanup rules and async use.</p>

<p dir="auto">Provider model catalogs change independently of Praval. The packaged model
registry is a tested capability snapshot. Production applications should
select and verify an explicit model name instead of relying on a moving
provider default.</p>
<p dir="auto">Local presets are available for Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and generic
OpenAI-compatible servers. Their default profiles are conservative. Enable
tools, media, structured output, or embeddings only when your endpoint supports
them. The <a href="https://github.com/aiexplorations/praval/blob/main/docs/sphinx/guide/local-llms.md">local model guide</a> shows how.</p>
